name: AI auditor
oneLiner: The build half of AI hiring runs about seven to one ahead of the governance half. Someone has to close that gap, and the role has no settled name.
why: Regulation attaches a permanent audit function to deployed AI
The hiring ratio says governance is understaffed relative to build
threats: It may arrive as a specialisation inside existing audit and compliance professions rather than a new title
If regulation thins out, the pressure behind the role thins with it

claims.text: A vendor study of 3,519 AI-related postings across eight EU countries found companies hire roughly seven people to build AI for every one hired to govern it — with the stated caveat that the study's author sells governance hiring.
